notes.title: WIP Update
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31945325/0c7120d7e8696d3883b20bd375f239232115675b.jpg


I am nearing completion of the rework. I am still deciding on some stuff, but most is nearly finished. Instead of just the trench as I originally wanted, the world will now be much bigger. And as mentioned the focus of the game is now different. Please join discord.gg/TM9wgxW to let me know how this looks and voice any suggestions. I will probably be looking for beta testers as well.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31945325/8844ebd6cf4cb6cb867d03aace73cb4097cb3278.jpg
